summary: Backend: 9/10 pytest passing. Frontend: 11/12 routes load; Treasury Recovery page renders with all required elements, security warnings, quick buttons, pre-filled destination, Phantom connect, funnel-out button. Two critical bugs found.

critical.issue: Uses dead host quote-api.jup.ag (DNS NXDOMAIN). Jupiter v6 endpoint was deprecated. Returns {ok:false, error:'[Errno -5] No address associated with hostname'}. Must migrate to https://lite-api.jup.ag/swap/v1/quote and https://lite-api.jup.ag/swap/v1/swap (verified working from container — returns valid route plan).

ui_bugs.issue: Treasury card displays 0.0000 SOL while top ticker shows 124.7 SOL from same backend endpoint. Either an integration bug (wrong field parsed, not awaiting /api/solana-balance response) or balance has not finished loading on initial render. Verify TreasuryRecovery.js sets balance from result.sol after fetch and check loading state.
React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Fix by removing span/icon nested inside <option> elements in SideHustle.js select dropdown.

integration_issues.issue: Visiting /api-pulse returns FastAPI 404 ({"detail":"Not Found"}) instead of React page. Kubernetes ingress routes anything matching prefix /api* to backend port 8001, and /api-pulse falls under that prefix. Rename the route to /apipulse or /pulse (and update Layout nav link + any internal Links).

action_items: Backend: migrate /api/swap-quote from https://quote-api.jup.ag/v6/quote to https://lite-api.jup.ag/swap/v1/quote (GET, same params).
Backend: migrate /api/create-swap-tx from https://quote-api.jup.ag/v6/swap to https://lite-api.jup.ag/swap/v1/swap (POST).
Frontend: rename /api-pulse route -> /apipulse (or /pulse) in App.js routes and Layout.js nav link; update all internal Links/buttons. This is required because K8s ingress treats /api* as backend.
Frontend: ensure TreasuryRecovery balance card binds to /api/solana-balance result.sol and refreshes; currently shows 0.0000 SOL while ticker shows 124.7 SOL.
Frontend: fix hydration warning on SideHustle page — remove <span> child inside <option> tags.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py mixes API and static file serving — fine for production, but app.mount('/', StaticFiles) at root masks /api-pulse via ingress not via FastAPI; consider distinct routing.
Two outbound integrations (quote-api.jup.ag) are not in production-ready state — needs migration audit for all Jupiter URLs.
/api/token-live-stats uses bare except: pass for Birdeye block — log instead of swallowing silently.
TokenMintConfig route has no auth; anyone can POST and overwrite mainnet mint config. Consider an admin key.
swap-quote assumes 9 decimals (SOL) for ALL inputs — multiplies amount * 1e9 even if inputMint is USDC (6 decimals). This is a real bug when input is not SOL.
seed_data_creation: none; token-mint config left cleared after lifecycle test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers health, token-mint CRUD, jupiter-price, solana-balance, token-live-stats, swap-quote, generate-mission, and invalid-input handling. After main agent migrates Jupiter URLs and renames /api-pulse, rerun pytest and re-verify the /apipulse (or new) route loads in the SPA and Treasury balance card populates with real SOL.
rca of the issue: 1) swap-quote: quote-api.jup.ag was sunset in 2025 in favor of lite-api.jup.ag/swap/v1. Container DNS confirms NXDOMAIN. Fix = change URL. 2) /api-pulse 404: Kubernetes ingress is configured to forward all paths starting with /api to backend (port 8001). The frontend route name itself collides with the ingress rule, so the request never reaches React. Fix = rename the path (and the Layout nav link href) to not start with /api.
